title: A wire across a part changes nothing
belief: A wire across bulb B is just an extra wire. The current still goes through the bulb, so nothing changes.
sources: Engelhardt, P. V. & Beichner, R. J. (2004). Students' understanding of direct current resistive electrical circuits. American Journal of Physics 72(1), 98–115. https://doi.org/10.1119/1.1614813
